name: How long does kitchen addition framing typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen addition framing typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen addition framing varies based on the size and complexity of the addition, as well as site conditions and weather. For a standard kitchen addition, framing might take anywhere from two to four weeks. This estimate includes preparing the foundation, erecting walls, installing roof trusses, and completing exterior sheathing. Inspections by local building authorities are also part of this phase and can influence the timeline, so efficient scheduling is key.
